fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary emphasizing Miami’s health advantages (sunshine, beaches, children’s health) as a civic promotional strategy; discussion of milk quality and public health including pasteurization and tuberculosis testing in dairy herds; prohibition-era notes on bootlegging and liquor enforcement; local civic items on traffic enforcement on Biscayne Boulevard, boulevard beautification, and a proposed post office site; society and entertainment columns focused on Miami Beach social life, visitors, and nightlife; and assorted satirical briefs and advertisements/coupons tied to local businesses and utilities.
